paper_title: Emission of Single and Few Electrons in XENON1T and Limits on Light Dark Matter
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, plotted directly
notes: XENON1T single/few-electron S2-only analysis setting 90% CL limits on several light DM models: DM-electron scattering (heavy/light mediator), electric/magnetic dipole and anapole interactions, bosonic dark photon and ALP absorption, and solar dark photons. The pre-analysis hint (DarkPhoton) matches the highlighted new parameter space for dark photons/solar dark photons (kinetic mixing chi). However, the paper text and provided excerpt contain only figure descriptions (Figs 13-16) with NO numerical tabulated values or explicit coupling numbers, so no (mass, coupling) data points could be extracted. Data would need to be read from exclusion plots not available here.
